text.p: Hewlett-Packard Co said on Monday that it has cut list prices on its HP OmniBook 5500 notebook PC series by as much as 21 percent.
HP said it has also cut list prices on its OmniBook 800 notebook PC and CD-ROM accessories for the HP OmniBook 5500 notebook PC.
"This price cut places us in strong competitive standing with other full-featured 133MHz Pentium notebooks on the market," the company said in a press release.

Estimated selling prices are expected to start at as low as $1,530 for the HP OmniBook 5500CS 5/100 notebook PC model 810, a 100 megahertz Pentium-processor-based system with an 810 megabyte hard drive and an 11.3-inch viewable-image passive-matrix display.
